text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer multi-paragraph argument with clear conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The essay maintains a more recognizable overall structure with an introduction, body paragraphs, and a closing."},{"evidence":"repeated linking of reasons to the main claim","quality":"coherence","description":"The writing more consistently connects ideas back to the central argument so the reader can follow the line of reasoning."},{"evidence":"more controlled sentence flow","quality":"sentence fluency","description":"The essay shows somewhat smoother control of sentence-to-sentence movement, even though it still has many errors."},{"evidence":"fewer abrupt formatting and punctuation breaks","quality":"presentation control","description":"The essay is more readable because its punctuation and paragraphing are less disruptive to the flow of the text."},{"evidence":"developed examples like lying, trust, Joker and Batman","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay more often expands claims with examples or illustrations rather than leaving points at a bare statement level."}]}
